description:
Render an interactive data table (sort, search, pagination) from already-fetched rows. Call
this when a tool response includes render_with="render-data-table": pass the rows through
unchanged, do not re-format them as a markdown table. columns is [{key, label}]; rows is an
array of objects keyed by column key. Keep array cell values as JSON arrays (do NOT flatten
them to comma-separated strings). Optionally set pageSize, and source={tool, params} for an
"Open in SEOcrawl" deep link.

Cost: free.

Examples:
```json
// Interactive table built from a get_top_pages list.
{"title":"Top pages","columns":[{"key":"url","label":"URL"},{"key":"clicks","label":"Clicks"}],"rows":[{"url":"/pricing","clicks":120},{"url":"/blog","clicks":90}]}
```

columns.description: Column definitions in display order. Each: key (matches row object keys) + label (header text).

rows.description: Row objects keyed by column key. Array values stay arrays (rendered as chips), not CSV strings.

source.description: Optional deep link target. tool = the bare data-tool name that produced these rows; params = its arguments.

params.description: The source tool's arguments, passed through verbatim. Include property so a deep link can be built.

name: render-data-table
title: Data table
